note: The root key records the consonants of the place name. Its derivation is unknown.
summary: Mesha marks one end of the territory inhabited by Joktan’s descendants. Genesis describes their settlement from Mesha toward Sephar.

senses.definition: The place marking the starting point in the description of the Joktanites’ territory.

evidence.note: מִמֵּשָׁא gives the starting point of their settlement, and בֹּאֲכָה סְפָרָה traces its extent toward Sephar.
